description: This file defines the MigrationAPI class, which extends an existing MigrationAPI class to handle migration-related API requests within the installer module of the OrangeHRM project. It specifically overrides the handleGet method to return migration map keys.

classes.name: MigrationAPI
classes.description: A controller class for handling migration-related API requests during installation, extending the base MigrationAPI class.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Overrides the parent handleGet method to return the keys of the MIGRATIONS_MAP, representing available migrations.
